about: Post and user records (appendix A 11-17). parser post: one raw Threads post object (as found at thread_items[].post or a share) to one record; parser user: one raw user object to one record or null when it has no identity. expected lists only the fields the case is about; a field not named is free. Times are UTC. All people, ids and links are synthetic. Every synthetic code is the shortcode of its post's pk (base64url digits, targets.json shortcodes), so a post URL names that same post with no request.

cases.name: identity-pk-first
cases.fact: pk is the identity; id is only a fallback, even when id names another usable post.

cases.name: identity-decimal-id
cases.fact: Without pk, an ASCII-decimal id is the identity.

cases.name: identity-composite-media-id
cases.fact: Some payloads carry only the media id <pk>_<author pk>; its numeric head is the post's identity.

cases.name: no-identity-is-a-tombstone
cases.fact: A post with no usable identity cannot be cited: it becomes an unavailable marker, not a dropped item.

cases.name: is-post-unavailable
cases.fact: is_post_unavailable marks a tombstone; the id is kept when present.

cases.name: attachment-tombstone
cases.fact: attachment_tombstone_info marks a tombstone.

cases.name: text-post-fields
cases.fact: taken_at is Unix seconds (UTC); the URL is /@user/post/code; the text is caption.text; counts come from like_count and text_post_app_info.

cases.name: taken-at-digit-string
cases.fact: taken_at may arrive as a decimal string.

cases.name: taken-at-unreadable
cases.fact: An unreadable time is no time: the post is undated, never dated now.

cases.name: counts-hidden-by-author
cases.fact: like_and_view_counts_disabled hides the like count: null, not 0.

cases.name: counts-as-strings
cases.fact: Counts may be decimal strings; anything else is unknown (null).

cases.name: photo-largest-candidate
cases.fact: media_type 1 is a photo; of its candidates the largest pixel area wins; accessibility_caption is the alt text (it may be machine-generated).

raw.accessibility_caption: May be an image of text that says 'hello'

media.alt: May be an image of text that says 'hello'

cases.name: video-prefers-video
cases.fact: media_type 2 is a video: the largest video version wins over any image.

cases.name: size-fallback-and-tie-order
cases.fact: Candidates without sizes tie (first wins), and the size falls back to original_width/original_height.

cases.name: carousel-items
cases.fact: media_type 8 is a carousel; its items are carousel_media, each its own photo or video.

carousel_media.accessibility_caption: May be a photo of a cat

media.alt: May be a photo of a cat

cases.name: media-without-url-dropped
cases.fact: A media item with no usable URL is not media.

cases.name: link-unwrapped
cases.fact: Threads routes outbound links through l.threads.com/?u=<destination>; the destination (http or https only) is the link. A preview is {url, title}.

cases.name: link-non-http-kept-wrapped
cases.fact: A destination that is not http or https is not unwrapped.

cases.name: reply-flags
cases.fact: A post is a reply when text_post_app_info.is_reply says so or reply_to_author is present; reply_to_id and root_post_id are kept as Threads sends them, never inferred.

cases.name: is-reply-explicit-false-wins
cases.fact: An explicit is_reply false is not overridden by reply_to_author.

cases.name: quote-two-voices
cases.fact: A quote is share_info.quoted_post: the quoting post's text is the quoter's, the quoted post keeps its own author, text and URL.

cases.name: repost-carries-original-date
cases.fact: A repost is share_info.reposted_post and adds no words; the shared post keeps its author and its own writing time (2025-10-09), never the time of the item that shares it (2026-10-08).
cases.verify: P2 R7: what the reposts tab item's own taken_at is (the repost time or the original's), and so which date a window over a reposts tab judges; until then only the shared post's date is a contract.

cases.name: quoted-tombstone-keeps-quoter
cases.fact: An unavailable quoted post is marked at its own level; the quoting post stays readable.

cases.name: share-cycle-cut
cases.fact: A share that contains its own ancestor is cut there as unavailable instead of recursing.

cases.name: share-depth-limit
cases.fact: Nested shares are cut at depth 8 (a bound on hostile or cyclic payload work): levels 0-7 are read, level 8 is an unavailable marker.

generate.shape: level i is {pk: first_pk + i, code: shortcode(first_pk + i), user: A} quoting level i + 1

cases.name: pinned
cases.fact: pinned_post_info.is_pinned_to_profile marks a pinned post; it sits first whatever its date.

cases.name: url-without-author
cases.fact: Without an author the post URL is /t/<code>.

cases.name: user-full
cases.fact: A user record: username, full_name, verification (is_verified, else text_post_app_is_verified), privacy (text_post_app_is_private), follower_count, biography, bio_links URLs, friendship_status, profile_pic_url, profile URL.

cases.name: user-threads-verification
cases.fact: Without is_verified, text_post_app_is_verified is the verification flag.

cases.name: user-without-identity
cases.fact: A user object with no pk and no decimal id is not a user record.

cases.name: user-follower-count-string
cases.fact: A follower count may be a decimal string; a formatted one is unknown.

cards.fact: A profile card shows the follower count Threads reports; Threads publishes no following or mutual count, so those are null (unknown) and graph following lists the accounts. The card's username must equal the requested handle; a mismatch is a changed response, never another person's card.
